body.name: certified rational implementation of the heavy-light interval
body.construction: Given \(\widetilde{\mathcal D}_{n,b}\) satisfying \(2^{-b}M\le\delta_{\mathrm{num}}/[64n(en)^{8L_n}]\), use \(b_{\mathrm{work}}\) working bits. Generate shifted-Chebyshev coefficient enclosures by the three-term recurrence and interval Clenshaw evaluation; generate every factorial monomial by \((N)_0=1\) and \((N)_{\ell+1}=(N)_\ell(N-\ell)\), followed by multiplication by its single outcome-mark enclosure; evaluate bounded-influence and exponential scores using outward dyadic interval arithmetic; invert each monotone two-sided score by bisection on \([0,2M]\) until its bracket has width at most \(\delta_{\mathrm{num}}/8\). Enlarge the exact-real endpoints from \(def:robust-heavy-light-interval-handle\) by the resulting certified arithmetic-error bounds and intersect with \([-2M,2M]\) to return \(\widehat C^{\mathrm{HL}}_{\delta_{\mathrm{num}}}\).
